title: Coal India's Mahanadi Coalfields IPO opens Nov 19

timeline.title: Coal India's Mahanadi Coalfields IPO opens Nov 19
timeline.line: A pure offer for sale of about 10% by Coal India, estimated at ₹9,500–10,000 crore
more: The issue runs November 19–23; the price band could be disclosed on November 16
Coal India is selling 66.18 crore shares; all proceeds go to the parent
Size estimates differ: about ₹9,500 crore in one report, about ₹10,000 crore in another

src.title: Coal India Arm Mahanadi Coalfields IPO to Open on November 19, Eyes ₹9,500 Crore
